proposal.reason: Main change is in transport: P2P/SHM connection setup, synchronization/progress accounting, and descriptor-based shared-memory handling for Copy-Engine control buffers. Add device-topology because a new NET-vs-P2P/SHM path decision (ncclTopoCheckNet and NET path-speed use) changes transport eligibility policy. Add memory because registered-address table allocation/update semantics changed to on-demand collective-only device tables with different P2P remote-address handling.
